context: Authenticated public Supabase client in the existing fictitious QA company

originalQuery.cause: PostgREST could not resolve the relationship between supplier_payment_allocations and invoice_id in its schema cache.
originalQuery.effect: The old reader ignored the query error and returned an empty allocations array.

replacement.allocationsRead: Select active allocations scoped by payment_id and the authenticated workspace organization_id.
replacement.invoiceRead: Select id, invoice_number and total_ttc only for the referenced invoice IDs, scoped by the same organization_id.
